svg.title: Our implementation roadmap
svg.desc: Development order, not the order of operations in a forward pass.; 1 · GPT backbone / Write DummyGPTModel to establish the overall structure.; 2 · Layer normalization → 3 · GELU activation / Implement the components that the outline still lacks.; 4 · Feedforward network → 5 · Shortcut connections / Use GELU inside the feedforward network; add residual paths.; 6 · Transformer block / Combine these pieces with Chapter 3’s multi-head attention.; 7 · Complete GPT architecture / Replace the dummy blocks and normalization with real modules.
svg.text: Development order, not the order of operations in a forward pass.
Write DummyGPTModel to establish the overall structure.
